    Sterman Pods¶

    "They weren't supposed to close. The ship stopped. The doors slammed. And then we weren't awake anymore." — Emrys, fragmented memory

    The Sterman Pods were specialized cryogenic chambers commissioned by the Sterman regime on Old Earth. Unlike standard colonization pods — which simply preserved occupants in suspended animation — the Sterman Pods had a secondary function: injection of an experimental black agent into the occupant's body during cryosleep.

    They were named after their creator. They became the coffin and the cradle of the two protagonists.

    Sterman — The Image¶

    Sterman was not a real person. He was an image — a constructed face of authority, projected onto every screen, printed on every wall, spoken in every broadcast. Like Big Brother from the old dystopian texts of the 20th century, Sterman was the personification of the totalitarian surveillance state that ruled Old Earth after the Shadow takeover of 2030.

    He was called the Antichrist by those who remembered the old words. He was the god of compliance. The face of the CBDC. The voice that told citizens to submit.

    Sterman commissioned the pods as part of a long-term project: the seeding of colony worlds with modified humans. The experimental black agent was designed to alter human biology at the genetic level — enhancing compatibility with alien environments, increasing survivability, and, in the regime's ultimate vision, creating a population that could be controlled at the biological level.

    The black agent in the Sterman Pods was experimental — not the final approved version. It had not been fully tested. The pods were placed on ships bound for the colonies as a trial run.

    The Pods That Caught Two Men¶

    When the rebels captured the AGI ship facility, they found rows of cryogenic pods. Most were standard colonization models. Two — at the end of a row, unmarked, their design slightly different — were Sterman Pods.

    Mikhail and Arkady (the man who would become Lucien) chose those two pods to sleep in. They did not close the doors. They only wanted to rest.

    The ship malfunctioned. A sudden engine stop — caused by an inexperienced pilot — threw the vessel into deceleration. The pod doors slammed shut. Cryogenization initiated automatically.

    Neither man knew what the pods were. Neither knew about the injection. They went to sleep as rebels. They woke up — three million years later — as something else.

    The Black Agent — Experimental Strain¶

    The black agent injected by the Sterman Pods was not the same substance that existed in the atmosphere of Ge'or or that created the Fallen Dragons. It was an earlier, experimental version — developed on Earth before the Last Great War, before humanity understood what they were working with.

    This experimental strain had one critical difference from later formulations: it was designed to incubate and rebirth. It was not a weapon. It was not a tool for creating hiveminds. It was a reincarnation mechanism — pure DNA programmed to seek a compatible host, enter, and be reborn.

    The irony: Sterman's regime designed the pods to create controlled, modified colonists. Instead, the pods preserved two rebels who would spend their next life trying to destroy everything Sterman's creators — the Shadows — had built.

    The Journey of the Pods¶

    The ship carrying the pods reached the asteroid belt. The rebels built colonies. They fought and lost to the Hybrians. The ship survived. Centuries later, retrofitted with warp drives, it was sent outside the solar system to a human settlement.

    Over thousands of years, the two sealed Sterman Pods were transferred between ships, between colonies, between research stations. The occupants inside remained frozen — preserved, unchanged, the experimental black agent circulating through their bodies, modifying, programming, waiting.

    Eventually, the pods arrived at The 157th Colony — the human weapons research facility on the planet Ge'or. The two bodies became test subjects. Scientists studied the black agent in their systems. They refined it. They tested it. They created the final iteration.

    When the Hybrians glassed the colony, the pods were in an underground bunker. They held. For three million years.

    The crash of the Glorious Alliance finally ruptured the body bags. The black agent bled into the earth.

    It found two women in 596 AGD. In 597 AGD, Emrys Eisenheart and Lucien Mortvagn were born.

    [ Sterman Pods ]
    ├── Commissioned By: Sterman — the image, the Antichrist, the face of Earth's surveillance state
    ├── Era: Post-2030 dystopian Old Earth
    ├── Function: Cryogenic preservation + experimental black agent injection
    ├── Black Agent Strain: Experimental — designed for incubation and rebirth
    ├── Occupants: Mikhail (Emrys) and Arkady (Lucien)
    ├── Activation: Accidental — ship malfunction slammed the doors shut
    ├── Journey: Asteroid belt → outer colonies → The 157th Colony (Ge'or)
    ├── Duration: ~3,000,000 years in cryosleep
    ├── Final Fate: Body bags ruptured by Glorious Alliance crash
    ├── Result: Black agent released — Emrys and Lucien born in 597 AGD
    └── Irony: Sterman's control mechanism created the weapon that would destroy his masters
